highlights:

highlights:
Saudi Arabia vs Uruguay lineups are yet to be confirmed for Group H Match 15 at the FIFA World Cup 2026. The Saudi Arabia national football team and Uruguay national football team meet on June 15, 2026, at Miami Stadium, with kickoff at 18:00 ET. This projected tracker covers the starting XI, formations, bench options, managers, and matchday lineup changes. This Saudi Arabia national football team vs Uruguay national football team lineups tracker stays projected until official match sheets arrive.

Saudi Arabia have announced a 30-player World Cup group under Georgios Donis, with Salem Al Dawsari, Saud Abdulhamid, Mohammed Kanno, Feras Al Buraikan, and Saleh Al Shehri among the main names. Uruguay’s final 26-man list remains yet to be confirmed, but Marcelo Bielsa’s camp picture includes Darwin Nunez, Ronald Araujo, Manuel Ugarte, Facundo Pellistri, Giorgian De Arrascaeta, and several expected senior arrivals. Official matchday lineups remain projected until both teams release their sheets.

Curaçao is likely to adopt a 4-3-3 formation, a setup that allows them to balance defensive solidity with attacking flair. Coach Fred Rutten is expected to emphasize a compact defensive structure, utilizing the strengths of central defenders like Juninho Albertus and Jurensley Martina. The full-backs, Brandley Deeke and Rangelo Room, will be tasked with providing width and supporting the attack. In midfield, the presence of a holding midfielder like Juninho Jansen will be crucial in breaking up opposition play and initiating counter-attacks. Offensively, Curaçao will rely on quick transitions, with wingers Eloy Albertus and Jurensley Jansen providing pace and creativity on the flanks. The central striker, likely Brandley Albertus, will be the focal point of their attack, aiming to capitalize on crosses and through balls.
